about.title: A Kandahar trading house built on trust
about.lead: Faiz Fayez LTD buys directly from growers and processors across southern Afghanistan and ships to buyers who need consistent quality and reliable delivery.
about.text: Every lot is sorted, graded and checked in Kandahar before it leaves, and we handle the paperwork and freight so our buyers receive exactly what they ordered.

points.title: Sourced at origin
points.text: Direct from orchards and processors in Kandahar and nearby provinces.

points.title: Graded and checked
points.text: Size, moisture and colour checked on every lot, with photos before dispatch.

points.title: Papers handled
points.text: Phytosanitary certificates, certificate of origin and customs clearance.

points.title: Delivered on time
points.text: Air, road and sea freight planned around each buyer’s schedule.

We ship from a few tons up to several hundred tons per order, depending on the product and season. Our track record shows the volumes we have delivered.
Dry fruits in cartons or bags to your specification; fresh fruit in ventilated boxes for air or road freight.
Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and phytosanitary certificate, plus any others your country requires.
